title: Alaska News Nightly: Friday, August 21, 2026
text:
Friday on Alaska News Nightly

A charter plane crash in a remote area of Southwest Alaska kills all eight on board, and Anchorage Assembly members voice concerns that an expanded crime surveillance center could impact privacy.

Plus, a Juneau teenager makes history as the city's first-ever female Eagle Scout.

Reports tonight from:

Evan Erickson in Bethel,Wesley Early and Hannah Flor in Anchorage,Tim Ellis in Delta Junction,Jamie Diep and Clarise Larson in Juneau,Katherine Irving in Kodiak,and Taylor Heckart in Petersburg.

This episode of Alaska News Nightly is hosted by Casey Grove with audio engineering from Toben Shelby and production by Kirsten Dobroth.
